decisions.reason: A core navigation and observation camera close to the established offer, with its own web page in both years, represents heavy sunk investment and visible commitment central to the firm's direction.
The modular navigation camera has proven itself publicly on ESA's HERA mission, which validates the commitment and strongly justifies continuing it.
The space situational awareness suite fits the announced expansion of observation applications, and any slow uptake can be attributed to long space procurement cycles.

Although the miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website, it matches the stated push toward compact sensors for docking and small satellites, so management persists given its prior investment.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera has its own web page and core relevance, and space-qualification costs already incurred argue for keeping it.
The asteroid navigation and imaging camera ties to the high-profile HERA heritage, making it a visible commitment that is worth continuing despite limited web presence.
